turnout.notes: Alabama turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout artifact is collected.

reviewCharts.sourceCoverage: Official Alabama SOS precinct XLS ZIP rows paired at county/precinct/reporting-mode column grain where U.S. House cells have explicit nonzero coverage; U.S. House is district-based and no 2024 Alabama U.S. Senate race existed.
reviewCharts.warning: Alabama review rows are President-versus-U.S. House comparisons from official SOS county XLS matrices. U.S. House is district-based and some split-district or absentee/provisional columns aggregate district coverage, so these rows are directional public-interest review signals, not findings.

historicalBaselines.warning: Alabama historical baseline rows are official county-level presidential context from SOS 2012, 2016, and 2020 artifacts. Use them as context only, not as 2024 certified data.
